purpose: Keep education transitions explicitly neutral in model version 1 until an official or separately validated transition model is introduced.
requiredChecks: model_data parameters qutbMode must equal identity
identityTransition must return a valid stochastic identity matrix
adding an explicit identity qutb matrix must not alter any population forecast output
the neutral qutb setting must remain replaceable without changing unrelated demographic components
governance: Level 4 for this component means the intentional no-effect placeholder is production-safe and reproducible; it does not mean an empirical education-transition model has been implemented.
Any future non-identity qutb implementation is a new candidate and requires its own pre-declared validation before replacing the neutral production mode.
